notes: Chronogolf tee times were being truncated at 24 per course per day — late afternoon and twilight slots were silently missing. Now pages through every result.
Chronogolf requests are throttled and back off on rate limits, which was causing three of the four courses to drop out entirely.
Failed requests now record the server's response, so a blocked course explains itself instead of just saying 403.
TeeWire requests send full browser headers in an attempt to get past Cloudflare from the scheduler.
